title: The Bitter Introduction
description: A cryptic note appears in your quarters: 'Utility above all. Meet me where shadows gather.' The handwriting is precise, cold.

title: The Moral Ledger
description: Fang Yuan presents you with a ledger of debts and favors. 'Choose wisely—every action has a price.'

title: Path Declaration
description: Fang Yuan tests your resolve: 'Will you choose the easy path of righteousness, or the difficult path of truth?'
